<div class="card-body">
'''Your Eyes Can Deceive You''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">目に頼ってはいかん</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">いずれかのプレイヤーのロストデッキの隣に配備する。そのデッキは裏向きにされる。そのプレイヤーのライフ・フォースからロストされたカードは、伏せられたままでロストする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-233o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「ブラスト・シールドを降ろしてちゃ、何も見えません。これじゃ、戦いようがない」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' You must not rely on your eyes.

'''Card text:''' Deploy next to either player's Lost Pile. Turn that pile face down. Cards lost from that player's Life Force are lost face down.

'''Lore:''' “With the blast shield down, I can't see anything. How am I supposed to fight?”
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Your Eyes Can Deceive You]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
